items.body_html: L0f runs before CREATE_INSTANCE; it produces inputs only — no transcript entry, no instance, no version. A rejection leaves the system untouched
template_ref carries a version; later overrides change slot values, never the definition
every required slot in the selected template has a non-none value in the result, else Rejected(unbound_required_slot)
a resolved value satisfies its slot's declared type (minimal command | branch | branch_pattern | path | string), else Rejected(slot_type_mismatch)
precedence template default < project global < project workflow < target < CLI/start override; same inputs → same ResolvedStartRequest
unknown slot ids are rejected only in the unambiguously-scoped tiers (workflow section, target, CLI); the shared global defaults and unrelated workflows' sections are not rejected for this run
an operator-selected command.target the workflow does not define rejects with unknown_target — an intentional selection, distinct from the lenient global-slot path
